original_target.title: Two stationary phases in a positive-rate nonlinear voter perturbation
original_target.area: Spatial population dynamics and phase coexistence

scope_comparison: The live Durrett section6.8 specifies the same four-neighbor perturbation with a3=5.5, small spontaneous flips, and fast voter motion. Its Open Problem6.8.1 still asks two translation-invariant stationary phases. Finite-time hydrodynamic/mean-curvature convergence and bistability of the limiting reaction do not supply the fixed-positive-epsilon stationary coexistence theorem.
